additional_info.subject: RE: ID0451537-DC/Si-D/CH-[MP / S0 170004109] DC2 Outlet not working CRM:02699000253
additional_info.body:
Hello Alexander,
Greetings of the day!
We checked and found the following error flags-
We need to check the converter onsite:
1.Please check if the power converter are properly connection to its shelf case.
2. Check for any loose connection of any power cable or CAN communication cables of the converter and measured the voltage across it with the help of multimeter. Check the resistance across CAN communication cables.
3. Please see to the display of the power converter whether it is OFF state or ON?
4. If all the steps are performed and you still see the power converter is faulty, we suggest you to replace it.
Attached KA for your reference:
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_Sicharge_D_Converter_ Missing converter in DC1,DC2,DC3,DC4 - (dynamics.com)
Also check the connections related to KF14 as follows:
We suggest you to carry the spare KF14 module along with you while going onsite. If found faulty, need to replace the same.
Do let us know if you have any other queries?
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavi Raut

additional_info.subject: ID0451537-DC/Si-D/CH-[MP / S0 170004109] DC2 Outlet not working CRM:00579001719
additional_info.body:
Hi guys, good afternoon.
The problem has been fixed. I believe that Fosco was right in that QA9-10 needed to be replaced but then when the replacement happened, most likely, the XD441 got a bit loose and when we got to site and pushed it inside, the charger was completely working again.
The reports from both sides have been added and I will close the ticket.
Thanks a lot and have a nice weekend!
Best regards,
Francisco
